argv:
import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
targets=["0000:0b:00.0","0000:0c:00.0"]
logs=subprocess.check_output(["journalctl","-k","-b","--no-pager"],text=True)
gpu=subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi","--query-gpu=pci.bus_id,name,driver_version,power.limit","--format=csv,noheader"],text=True)
cmdline=Path("/proc/cmdline").read_text().strip()
report={"boot_id":Path("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id").read_text().strip(),"kernel":subprocess.check_output(["uname","-r"],text=True).strip(),"kernel_cmdline":cmdline,"unlocked_messages":[line for line in logs.splitlines() if any(f"pci {t}: gpu_unlock: unlocked" in line for t in targets)],"xid_messages":[line for line in logs.splitlines() if "NVRM" in line and "Xid" in line],"gpu_state_csv":gpu,"drivers":{t:(Path("/sys/bus/pci/devices")/t/"driver").resolve().name for t in targets}}
assert all(any(f"pci {t}: gpu_unlock: unlocked" in line for line in report["unlocked_messages"]) for t in targets)
assert all(v=="nvidia" for v in report["drivers"].values())
assert not report["xid_messages"]
assert "gpu_unlock.targets="+",".join(targets) in cmdline.split()
p=Path("systems/dual-rtx3090/installation/activation.json")
p.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
